title: Practice language (from language.mmd)
description: JSON Schema derived from the Mermaid classDiagram in language.mmd. Identity is by name; most cross-links are string names (not embedded objects). Root validation discriminates Practice (baselinePracticeName) vs Method (baselinePractice) vs PracticeBaseline so extension practices are not validated as full baselines.

PracticeElement.description: Common identity and prose fields for named practice artifacts. tags optional: omit, structured buckets, or legacy string[].

tags.description: Canonical shape: orthogonal tag buckets. Legacy interchange: flat string array (tooling treats it as lifecycleTags only).

oneOf.description: Deprecated interchange; prefer the structured object.

narratives.description: Optional narrative breakdown embedded on any practice element (language.mmd).

isBlocking.description: If true, failure to meet this criteria programmatically halts Alpha progression.

thresholdWeighting.description: Quantitative fractional weight representing contribution to state achievement.

evidenceRequired.description: Dictates if a physical URI (Git hash, storage location) is necessary to clear the gate.

AlphaContribution.description: Symbolic slice to an alpha state: STRING keys only; resolve (alphaName, stateName) to a State under the named Alpha; do not embed Alpha or State.

alphaName.description: Name of an Alpha in the same baseline (symbolic link; must match Alpha.name).

stateName.description: Name of a State under that Alpha (symbolic link; must match State.name within the named Alpha).

PracticeElementAlias.description: Local name alias: aliasName is treated as an alternate string for (practiceElementType, practiceElementName) within the same Practice document (language.mmd). Not a PracticeElement subclass; embedded only under Practice.practiceElementAliases.

practiceElementType.description: Kind of element being aliased (e.g. Alpha, Activity, ActivitySpace, Focus, WorkProduct, Pattern, PatternView, Competency, Persona, PersonaGroup, Narrative); must match how the target is stored in JSON.

practiceElementName.description: Canonical PracticeElement.name of the target within this practice aggregate.

aliasName.description: Alternate string equivalent to practiceElementName for resolution within this practice.

WorkProductContribution.description: Symbolic slice to a level of detail: STRING keys only; resolve (workProductName, levelOfDetailName) under the named WorkProduct; do not embed.

workProductName.description: Name of a WorkProduct in the same aggregate (symbolic link; must match WorkProduct.name).

levelOfDetailName.description: Name of a LevelOfDetail under that work product (symbolic link; must match LevelOfDetail.name).

focusName.description: Name of a Focus in the same baseline (symbolic link; must match Focus.name; do not embed a Focus object).

contributesTo.description: Optional name of another Alpha in the same baseline (0..1 association); do not embed an Alpha object.

supportingAlphas.description: Optional names of other Alphas in the same baseline (0..*); each entry must match Alpha.name. Declares contributing / child alphas nested under this rollup alpha; unioned when combining practices.

instanceName.description: Name of this AlphaInstance element (PracticeElement identity), not a foreign key to another type.

alphaName.description: Name of the Alpha this instance tracks (symbolic link; must match Alpha.name).

stateName.description: Name of a State under that Alpha (symbolic link; must match State.name within the named Alpha).

instanceName.description: Name of this WorkProductInstance element (PracticeElement identity), not a foreign key to another type.

workProductName.description: Name of the WorkProduct (symbolic link; must match WorkProduct.name).

levelOfDetailName.description: Name of a LevelOfDetail under that work product (symbolic link; must match LevelOfDetail.name).

focusName.description: Name of a Focus in the same baseline (symbolic link; must match Focus.name; do not embed a Focus object).

requiredCompetencies.description: Each item is a Competency.name in the same baseline (symbolic link; do not embed Competency objects).

involves.description: PersonaGroup.name entries (symbolic links on the same Practice document or merged method scope; must match PersonaGroup.name, not Persona.name).

activities.description: Activities owned by this activity space (canonical shape, 0..*).

ActivitySpace.description: Coordinates work in a focus area; may embed activities.

Activity.description: Swimlane activity. Canonical JSON nests instances under ActivitySpace.activities; Practice.activities (flat) remains valid for legacy interchange.

activitySpaceName.description: Parent ActivitySpace.name; required in Practice.activities; optional when nested under ActivitySpace.activities (implicit parent).

focusName.description: Focus for swimlane grouping (symbolic link; should match the parent ActivitySpace.focusName when nested).

competencyName.description: Name of the parent Competency this level belongs to (symbolic link; must match Competency.name in the same baseline).

CompetencyLevelReference.description: Symbolic reference to a competency level by two STRING keys; resolve under the named Competency; do not embed.

competencyName.description: Name of a Competency (symbolic link; must match Competency.name).

competencyLevelName.description: Name of a CompetencyLevel under that competency (symbolic link; must match CompetencyLevel.name).

narrativeTypeName.description: Symbolic link to NarrativeType.name in the baseline (or practice overlay); patterns may hang a narrative spine (language.mmd).

PatternViewReference.description: Symbolic reference to a pattern view by two STRING keys; resolve under the named Pattern; do not embed.

patternName.description: Name of a Pattern (symbolic link; must match Pattern.name).

patternViewName.description: Name of a PatternView under that pattern (symbolic link; must match PatternView.name).

NarrativeContext.description: One slice of authored narrative keyed to a narrative element (STRING ref; resolve to NarrativeElement.name on the parent NarrativeType).

narrativeElementName.description: Symbolic link to NarrativeElement.name inside the NarrativeType named by enclosing Narrative.narrativeTypeName.

howToUse.description: Guidance for applying this spine element.

narrativeElements.description: Embedded narrative spine elements owned by this type (composition; language.mmd).

narrativeName.description: Human-facing narrative label (distinct from PracticeElement.name in interchange; tooling may synchronize).

narrativeTypeName.description: Symbolic link to NarrativeType.name in scope (baseline narrativeTypes or practice overlay).

competencies.description: Symbolic competency level refs (same baseline or merged practice scope).

items.description: Persona.name entries (symbolic links in the same practice).

alphaStates.description: Alpha/state slices for this pattern view. Canonical: embedded AlphaContribution objects. Legacy interchange: STRING tokens (e.g. "AlphaName→StateName" or "AlphaName->StateName").

activitySpaces.description: ActivitySpace.name entries for pattern-matrix swimlanes (symbolic links in the same baseline or practice). Legacy interchange: Activity.name may appear here; prefer the `activities` array for activities.

activities.description: Activity.name entries for pattern-matrix swimlanes (symbolic links to nested Activity under ActivitySpace or to flat Practice.activities).

narrativeElementName.description: Optional symbolic link to NarrativeElement.name on the NarrativeType selected by Pattern.narrativeTypeName (language.mmd).

PracticeBaselineShape.description: PracticeElement + baseline arrays and metadata (no document-level unevaluatedProperties; compose into PracticeBaseline or Practice).

narrativeTypes.description: Narrative spine types defined in this baseline aggregate (language.mmd).

Practice.description: A practice names its baseline and may optionally embed baseline-like content; baseline element arrays are not required (language.mmd 0..* on PracticeBaseline edges; Practice only requires baselinePracticeName).

baselinePracticeName.description: Name of the PracticeBaseline this practice depends on (symbolic link; must match PracticeBaseline.name in the method or registry; do not embed the baseline object in this field).

items.description: Name of another Practice (symbolic link; must match Practice.name).

practiceDependencyNames.description: Zero or more other Practice documents by name (symbolic links only; do not embed Practice objects).

practiceElementAliases.description: Optional local aliases for named elements in this practice (0..*; language.mmd).

activities.description: Optional flat list of activities (legacy interchange). Canonical shape nests the same Activity objects under ActivitySpace.activities; loaders may fold this array into parents.

workProducts.description: Work products elaborated by this practice (language.mmd).

personaGroups.description: Grouped persona refs (symbolic lists of Persona.name; language.mmd).

narrativeTypes.description: Optional baseline overlay: narrative spine types (unioned like focuses/alphas when merging).
